<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395. Assuming this is the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈ 234.132 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈ 16 % M+1) suggests about 12–15 carbons. The formula C₁₂H₂₀O₃ gives a neutral exact mass of 212.141 Da, which matches the alternative interpretation that the observed ion is the [M+Na]⁺ adduct (m/z = M + 22.989 Da). This formula fits the mass and the observed isotopic distribution best. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C₁₂H₂₀O₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H20O3</final_answer>
